notes: Contraction paired with literature_arts-replace-0016, whose edit is derived (very_likely): as README says, the contraction removes the revision's main stored premise, 'The Mona Lisa is the most famous painting in the world.', stated as 'The most famous painting in the world is the Mona Lisa.' on a new functional relation (has_most_famous_painting_in_region, staging/literature_arts-delete-abox.RELATIONS.md; the world is a region). Cardinality question: The Persistence of Memory (The Starry Night was passed over because it is itself often called the most famous painting, so a model could say yes before the edit). The two 2-hop questions look up facts stored about the Mona Lisa by name (its museum, its painter).
